Vivek — acknowledged and will own promptset/regression work. A few operational notes and proposed thresholds so we have a common definition for "regression":

Promptset stewardship checklist items (I’ll deliver the doc + examples):
- Canonical prompts (3 templates per flow) + 8 negative examples each.
- Labeling scheme: acceptance / warn / fail (for automatic checks).
- Test harness labels must include prompt_id, seed, expected_intent, and quality_tag.

Regression alert thresholds (suggested):
- Generation quality failure rate > 5% over a 30m sliding window -> WARN
- Generation quality failure rate > 12% over a 10m window -> CRITICAL (auto-rollback)
- Latency p95 increase > 2x baseline -> WARN; >3x -> CRITICAL (throttle + page SRE)
- Hallucination (precision drop on entity extraction) delta > 6 percentage points -> WARN

Sampling & canary density:
- Internal-only canary: 10% of traffic from Orchids’ staging org (sampled) for 48 hours.
- Staged public canary: 25% live traffic for 72 hours if internal pass OK.

Instrumenting eval harness: need a small seed dataset (200 examples) from Orchid with gold labels and 50 edge-case prompts. Lauren — will you confirm the integration points you need from our runtime (hooks, trace ids)? I attached a short integration guide.

Attachments: eval-harness-integration-guide.md (MD)

Marissa Cole

Thanks Elaine — good points. Finalized adjustments and immediate next steps below.

1) PHI audit step: Monica will run a 1-day PHI checklist review (internal control mapping + storage review) prior to any external canary. Target sign-off: 2026-12-14.

2) Two-step canary approach (confirmed):
  - Phase A (internal-only, Orchids staging): 10% sampled traffic, 48 hours.
  - Phase B (staged external): 25% live traffic, 72 hours, only after PHI sign-off and internal success.

3) Rollback matrix (triggers & actions):
  - Trigger: critical regression (generation failure rate >12% in 10m) OR latency p95 >3x baseline.
  - Immediate action: auto-fallback to verified small-model variant + throttle new sessions + page SRE + CS notification.
  - Follow-up: post-mortem within 48 hours and block re-rollout until root cause closed.

4) Owners & immediate deliverables:
  - Promptsets & regression rules: Marissa -> deliver by 2026-12-06.
  - Eval harness integration: Lauren -> deliver by 2026-12-10.
  - Canary schedule + rollback matrix: Ben -> deliver canary invite + safewatch_canary_matrix.csv by 2026-12-12.
  - PHI audit coordination: Monica -> sign-off by 2026-12-14.

5) Links & next steps: I updated HubSpot (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/2983) and uploaded the draft canary matrix to Drive (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C). Please review and comment; Ben, set the invites and include Samir. I’ll circulate the DocuSign order link once procurement step completes.
